title: Not Others
desc: Xi had been in love with Yan, her childhood friend, but struggled to express her feelings. Her approach to Yan was extreme, as she couldn't find a suitable way to convey her emotions. Many years later, one afternoon, as Yan was about to leave, she discovered her true emotional needs in her memories. This led to a romantic farewell and the beginning of their love.
